[Source: Leave Policy]
1. Employees receive 10 casual leaves and 15 sick leaves annually.
2. Casual leaves require 48 hours prior notice.
3. Maternity leave is 12 weeks fully paid; paternity leave is 2 weeks fully paid.
4. Unused sick leaves can be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days.

[Source: Working Hours & Attendance]
5. Working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
6. Lunch break is 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM daily.
7. Attendance must be logged before 9:30 AM via the internal portal.
8. More than 3 late arrivals per month results in a half-day deduction.
9. Overtime compensation is applicable for pre-approved work beyond 40 hours/week.

[Source: IT & Cybersecurity]
10. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and require 12+ characters.
11. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all company accounts.
12. Company laptops must not be used for personal streaming or unauthorized software downloads.
13. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT Security within 2 hours.

[Source: Code of Conduct & Office Policies]
14. Harassment or discrimination of any kind results in immediate termination.
15. Office dress code is business casual, Monday through Thursday, and casual on Fridays.
16. Confidential company documents must not be uploaded to unapproved public AI tools.
17. Bringing pets to the office is strictly prohibited unless authorized for accessibility needs.

[Source: Internship & Onboarding Guidelines]
18. Internships last 6 weeks with a mandatory 36 working days commitment.
19. Interns receive 2 casual leaves during their tenure.
20. Final internship completion certificates require 85%+ evaluation scores and project approval.
